items.question: How many days is the Eid Al Adha public holiday in the UAE?
items.gold: Eid Al Adha (Feast of Sacrifice) is 3 days, from 10 to 12 Dhu Al Hijjah.
items.fact: Eid Al Adha public holiday lasts three days

items.question: Under UAE Cabinet Resolution No. 27 of 2024, can a public holiday be transferred to another day when it falls on a weekend?
items.gold: No, a public holiday cannot be transferred to another day if it falls on the weekend.
items.fact: Public holidays cannot be moved when falling on weekends
